description: Issue labels for ginsys repos managed from ginsys/.github. See labels.md for the conventions.

labels.name: type/investigation
labels.description: Reproducible evidence to evaluate alternatives and enable a decision

labels.name: type/decision
labels.description: Owner decision with recorded rationale and consequences

labels.name: type/specification
labels.description: Detailed contracts grounded in accepted design and evidence

labels.name: type/implementation
labels.description: Implementation of a refined and approved work item

labels.name: type/validation
labels.description: Evidence review or integrated acceptance assessment

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Defect in shipped behaviour; used once code ships

labels.name: type/feature
labels.description: New capability in shipped code; used once code ships

labels.name: status/in-progress
labels.description: Responsibility accepted and work underway; exclusive with needs-review

labels.name: status/needs-review
labels.description: Ready for owner or designated review; exclusive with in-progress

labels.name: status/needs-refinement
labels.description: Implementation detail or acceptance verification still needs refinement

labels.name: area/api
labels.description: Management API and UI: auth, RBAC, drafts, review, releases, operations, inventory

labels.name: area/database
labels.description: Application database: inventory, YAML sources, profiles, revisions, assignments, journals

labels.name: area/secrets
labels.description: Secret/crypto providers: Talos secret bundles, credentials, enrolment signing, Transit

labels.name: area/compiler
labels.description: Configuration compiler: fragments, secret generation, pinned Talos contract, full config

labels.name: area/publisher
labels.description: Release publisher: immutable releases, encrypted per-machine artifacts, diffs, provenance

labels.name: area/operations
labels.description: Operation engine: intent, dispatch and evidence journals; resumable apply and lifecycle

labels.name: area/transport
labels.description: Machine transport layer: direct TCP, SideroLink or site relay to the Talos API

labels.name: area/observer
labels.description: Kubernetes observer: drain, Node readiness, PDB failures, cluster health

labels.name: area/observability
labels.description: Observability and audit: metrics, events, machine logs, operation timeline, audit records

labels.name: area/design
labels.description: Design documents and research under docs/design

labels.name: area/docs
labels.description: Repository documentation outside design references: README, CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS

labels.name: area/ci
labels.description: Workflows, checks, repo tooling and org-standards consumption

labels.name: area/store
labels.description: SQLite schema and state machine (internal/store)

labels.name: area/dispatch
labels.description: Ordinary send/dispatch and the Transport interface (internal/dispatch)

labels.name: area/controller
labels.description: The protected controller: grants, revocations, renewals (internal/controller, cmd/parleyctl)

labels.name: area/adapters
labels.description: Claude-side and Codex-side transport adapters and reply-marker parsing

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Dependency updates

labels.name: needs-human
labels.description: Renovate: update needs human review before merge

labels.name: unattended
labels.description: Renovate: update eligible for automerge without review

labels.name: security
labels.description: Renovate: update fixes a known vulnerability (vulnerabilityAlerts)
